hits.title: Football Legends!
hits.description: ⚽ Grab a team and play quick football duels! Aim your shots, upgrade your squad and lift the Legends Cup 🏆
hits.howToPlayText: Drag your finger to aim and launch a football player to kick the ball. Each match lasts until two goals are scored or the timer runs out. Use power-ups, aim precisely, and take the top spots in tournaments!
